refined_nucleus: A vascular graft with an embedded, porous ceramic layer infused with a broad-spectrum antimicrobial agent and a novel biodegradable polymer layer that enhances the structural integrity of the graft is designed to reduce graft infection risk by incorporating a ceramic-polymer interface layer.
new_relationship: The ceramic-polymer interface layer creates a technical effect by enhancing the compatibility between the ceramic particles and the biodegradable polymer.
new_configuration: The ceramic-polymer interface layer is designed to be a thin, porous layer that allows for the controlled release of antimicrobial agents.
new_control_rule: The control rule is to maintain a consistent ceramic-polymer interface layer thickness to ensure optimal compatibility and release of antimicrobial agents.
refined_structure: The vascular graft consists of an ePTFE luminal layer, a biodegradable polymer layer, a ceramic-polymer interface layer, and an embedded, porous ceramic layer.
refined_causal_chain: Ceramic-polymer interface layer release of antimicrobial agents
